title: Work Video: local video upload playback + resilient montage fallback

requirements.summary: Support local video file upload for the Work Video section and play the selected video inline with native controls.
acceptanceCriteria: In the Work Video section, users can choose a video file from their device via a file picker.
After selecting a video, the page shows an inline HTML5 <video> player with Play/Pause, seek, volume, and fullscreen controls.
If the user clears/removes the selected video, the UI returns to the default Work Video experience (montage or placeholder).
All user-facing labels and messages in this feature are in English.

file_operations.description: Add a dedicated local video upload control (accepting common formats like .mp4/.webm) that creates an object URL and renders an inline HTML5 video element with standard controls; ensure cleanup by revoking the object URL when replaced/cleared/unmounted. Use existing shadcn-ui components (Button, Card, Input, Label) to keep styling consistent—verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

requirements.summary: Make the default Work Video montage reliably render by validating default asset paths and adding a graceful fallback when montage images fail to load.
acceptanceCriteria: If any default montage image URL from WORK_PHOTOS fails to load, the Work Video section shows a clear English fallback state (e.g., “Work video is not available yet. Please upload a video or add photos.”) instead of a blank/black canvas.
The app does not crash if one or more montage images are missing or fail to load.
WORK_PHOTOS is updated to only reference files that actually exist in the frontend public assets, or the code is updated to avoid relying on missing paths.

file_operations.description: Review and adjust WORK_PHOTOS so it only contains valid public asset paths that exist; keep paths consistent with the current public assets structure to avoid broken montage sources.

Add robust montage image loading error handling (e.g., track failed loads via Image.onerror, skip broken images where possible, and show a clear English fallback message overlay/state instead of rendering a blank canvas). Use existing shadcn-ui components (Card/Button) for fallback UI actions—verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Harden montage recording against missing/broken image paths by handling image load failures gracefully (e.g., skip failed images and/or provide a user-friendly error if no images can be loaded) so recording does not crash the app.

requirements.summary: Clarify whether the Work Video section is showing an uploaded video or the montage, and provide explicit controls to switch/clear selection.
acceptanceCriteria: The Work Video section indicates whether the user is viewing an uploaded video or the photo montage.
There is an explicit control to remove/clear the uploaded video selection and revert to montage mode.
The section remains responsive and visually consistent with the existing site styling (Tailwind + existing UI components).

file_operations.description: Update the Work Video UI to include an obvious mode indicator (Uploaded video vs Photo montage), add an explicit 'Clear/Remove video' control that reverts to montage mode, and ensure responsive layout continuity. Compose existing shadcn-ui components (Button/Card/Label/Input) rather than editing ui component files—verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.
